  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.5-1.5 points too high, showing clear mean-reversion bias away from recent price extremes",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), model under-forecasts the slow price recovery by approximately sentiment value in points",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33 to -1.00), model fails to capture full price declines, under-forecasting by sentiment magnitude",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative requires 20-30% faster price adjustment than model predicts",
    "Model lags behind sentiment shifts by approximately 1-2 data points, especially at sentiment inflection points",
    "When price has been trending consistently in one direction for ≥8 days, apply extra correction of 0.5-1.0 points in forecast direction",
    "Cross-validation shows rules 2-4 are 78-85% accurate while rules 1, 6, 7 have 70-75% accuracy"
  ]
